A '''manta pear''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]].<ref name="Menu" /> The [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],  offered manta pear [[Syrup/Legends|syrup]] as an optional flavoring for the [[fizzyglug]] drinks it sold<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
Manta pears were first mentioned in ''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]'', a [[1993]] [[Canon|non-canon]] book written by [[Bob Carrau]] that collected various pieces of concept art from projects made by [[George Lucas]]. The pears were mentioned in an "employee of the month" award given to a [[Unidentified Gamorrean guard (employee of the month)|Gamorrean guard]] who among other things, brought dignity to his uniform even when it was covered in rotten manta pears.<ref name="Monsters and Aliens">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref> On [[December 3]], [[2009]], Manta pears were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a canon article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an in-universe menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Menu" />
